translation: And cooperate in righteousness and piety.
cta: Take one extra mat with you this Friday — make their prayer more comfortable and earn extra blessings.

arabic: إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَاةِ مِن يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَاسْعَوْا إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
translation: When the call is made for prayer on the day of Jumu'ah, hasten to the remembrance of Allah.
cta: Heading to Jummah? Take a second mat with you before you leave.

arabic: وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ
translation: Allah helps His servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
translation_source: Own rendering; sunnah.com: 'Allah is at the back of a servant so long as the servant is at the back of his brother' (excerpt)
cta: Bring one for your brother or sister this Friday.

arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.
cta: No good is too small. Take one extra mat with you this Friday.

arabic: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ
translation: Whoever guides someone to good will have a reward like the one who does it.
translation_source: Own rendering; sunnah.com: 'One who guides to something good has a reward similar to that of its doer'
cta: Share this with someone who goes to Jummah.

translation: So race to all that is good.
cta: Be the one with the spare mat this Friday.

arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
translation_source: Own rendering; sunnah.com: 'None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself'
cta: You'd want a mat if you arrived late. Bring one for someone who does.

arabic: خَيْرُ يَوْمٍ طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ
translation: The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday.
cta: Make the best day easier for someone — bring one extra mat.
Someone will pray on the pavement this Friday. Bring them a mat.

translation_source: Own rendering; sunnah.com: 'Enjoining, all that is good is a Sadaqa'
cta: One extra mat in your bag is sadaqah waiting for its moment.

arabic: وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ
translation: Whatever good you put forward for yourselves, you will find it with Allah.
cta: Keep a spare mat ready — at home, at work, in the car. Let it do good every Friday.

arabic: فِيهِ سَاعَةٌ لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ
translation: On Friday there is an hour: no Muslim who is praying and asks Allah for something at that time, except that He gives it to him.
translation_source: Own rendering; Arabic per Sahih Muslim 852a (sunnah.com); 'fihi' = on Friday
cta: Help someone reach that hour in prayer — take one extra mat with you.
